findings.message: The new AZDO_REPO encoding is covered by only two rows (existing %XX and a raw space). Round 3 asked for secret-path variants over a raw space, existing %XX, a lone '%', non-ASCII, '?' and '#'. Org and project got the full table, but repo did not. Add the missing repo rows. `url_seg` is shared, so this is a coverage gap, not a behaviour bug.
findings.scenario: If `url_seg` were later changed for repo only, or an AZDO_REPO of `100%` or `r#1` bypassed the encoding, no test would fail, because only space and %20 are asserted for repo.
